Technical/Functional Skills : 
 

 Strong knowledge in Java /J2EE application architecture and frameworks 
 Web Application architecture and design 
 Webservices implementation and integration 
 Strong knowledge on Data flow in Web applications  
 Hands on experience on design and development of J2EE web applications 
 Strong knowledge on Javascript, JSP, Servlets  
 Websphere Portal Knowledge is an added advantage 
 Knowledge on Ajax, JQuery, HTML5, Web Content Management 
 Be well versed with frameworks like Struts and Spring 
 Experience in Hibernate or other ORM’s 
 Experience in application build and deployment 
 Possess strong knowledge of SDLC concepts (Software development life cycle) and web application design
 

 Experience Required : 
 

 6-8+ years of experience in Web application development  
 Minimum 3+ years of experience in Web Sphere Portal  
 Java (J2SE) and Enterprise Java (J2EE) technologies 
 Web Services/SOAP 
 Application deployment and configuration in WebSphere application Server console. 
 SQL and ORM Knowledge

 Bachelor of Engineering; Masters degree preferred
